newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cowen ups Xerox to strong buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cowen ups Xerox to strong buy.

text.p: -- Cowen & Co said Monday it raised its rating on Xerox Corp to strong buy from neutral.

-- Cowen also raised Xerox's 1996 earnings forecast to $3.30 a share from $3.25 a share. For the 1996 fourth quarter, Cowen raised its estimate for Xerox by $0.05 a share to a range of $1.15 to $1.18 a share.
-- Cowen also boosted Xerox's 1997 earnings view to $3.80 a share from $3.70 a share.
-- Additional details were not immediately available.
-- Xerox jumped 1-1/2 to 53 in morning trading.
